caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with a natural brown finish. The dresser features four drawers on its front: three larger drawers below and a smaller, slightly recessed pair of drawers at the top. Each drawer has a single round knob for pulling. The dresser is rendered in a three-quarter view, showing its front and right side; the side panel is framed with a beveled edge. The dresser sits on a base with cut-out feet. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or embellishments surrounding the furniture. The dresser is the sole object in the image and is centered on the canvas.
title: Shaker Sewing Desk
